boundary_edition_note: Official PRG resource 2355394, 2026-08-03, still listed by national portal at 2026-10-29 retrieval; retained member hashes verified. No claim of equality to unavailable live WFS. Complete current TERC code set equals PRG; current TERC/SIMC contents equal June 2026 edition.

interned.note: Ledger fields ending in polygon_sha256 or polygon_wkb_sha256 hold an index into polygon_sha256; boundary member fields hold an index into boundary_members.

methods: Unique current own P1653 whole-gmina identity and explicit municipal class; CC0 own P625 copied at eight decimals and strictly contained in official own PRG gmina and powiat; GUS Tabela_III column C whole-gmina total at 2026-06-30. Never reuse a settlement item or an already used item. Only literal own-item translations; no fallback.

Literal own-item current SIMC identifies independent village/town; official SIMC hierarchy maps town/rural component kinds 4/5 to whole mixed gmina kind 3. Require official name, same state and powiat, strict own PRG gmina/powiat containment of unchanged stored point, and adjacent level 3 municipal parent. Change only a null parent_id. An unresolved key requires explicit same-v4-locality review.
